newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $5.18 bln for week of Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $5.18 bln for week of Oct 28.

text.p: In one of the busiest weeks so far in 1996, scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $5.18 billion in 142 offerings for the week October 28, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $812 million in 77 offerings. The largest issue is a $133 million Virginia Public Schools Authority issue on October 30.
Tuesday has the busiest competitive sales slate with $394 million in 46 offerings, followed by $330 million in 13 offerings on Thursday.
Negotiated sales total $4.368 billion in 65 offerings. The largest issue is a taxable $775 million New York State Dormitory Authority issue through Lehman Brothers.
An additional 13 negotiated deals totaling $338 million are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.

Not included in the sales total is a total of $660 million of California University Regents commercial paper in two offerings: a $550 million issue senior managed by Morgan Stanley & Co and a $160 million offering senior managed by JP Morgan & Co.
